data.body:
AMENDMENT — deeper finding (this sprint is ci-pr mode, not local):

The original bug body framed this as missing DSO-Story-Merge trailers. The trailer absence is a symptom; the root cause is bigger.

Verified state on f360-3a5b sprint:
- .claude/dso-config.conf has dso.workflow=ci-pr (NOT local)
- SPRINT_MODE detection returns 'ci-pr'
- sprint Phase A Step 'Draft PR Creation' DID fire and created the long-lived draft PR #344 (session->main)
- sprint Phase E DID create story/f360-3a5b-b8f3-4f86/<story-id> branches for the 10 stories
- BUT: zero story PRs were ever opened — gh pr list --base worktree-20260524-151656 returns 0
- BUT: review-sub-pr.yml never fired (no story PRs to trigger on)
- BUT: GitHubPRDefenseStore has zero per-story defense records
- Therefore: PR #344's ci.yml llm-review reviews the full 48-commit diff as integration scope

Where Phase F Step 18 ci-pr branch should have executed:
```bash
if [[ "${SPRINT_MODE:-local}" == "ci-pr" ]]; then
    SESSION_BRANCH=$(bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/resolve-session-branch.sh")
    export BRANCH="$STORY_BRANCH"
    export STORY_PR_BASE="$SESSION_BRANCH"
    bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/merge-to-main.sh"   # opens story->session PR
fi
```

What I did instead: `git merge <agent-isolation-commit-sha> --no-edit` from the session worktree, for every story.

Per-story PR creation, per-story LLM review, defense-store population, and integration-scope suppression were ALL bypassed. The trailer absence is just the visible artifact.

Acceptance criteria addition for this bug:
- [ ] sprint Phase F Step 18 hard-enforces the ci-pr branch when SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr — block direct git merge from orchestrator; route every story closure through merge-to-main.sh STORY_PR_BASE
- [ ] dso:completion-verifier Phase G Step 2 verifies: in ci-pr mode, every closed child story has a merged or in-review story->session PR in GitHub history
- [ ] sprint Phase F adds a pre-flight check that refuses to call `git merge <ref>` directly on a session-active worktree when SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr (force the merge-to-main.sh path)
